title: ✨ Sr Front-End / Frontend / UI Platform Engineer — React⚛︎ + TypeScript | Toronto-ish / Canada REMOTE?? | FE-773
description:
This posting was scraped from LinkedIn + our careers page + at least one cache, so punctuation and fields disagree. 🏢 Employer-ish Northstar Commerce Cloud Inc. Req / ref: 02-SENIOR_FRONTEND_ENGINEER / internal maybe REQ-9002 Status: OPEN? ✅ unless a cache is stale. Posted 2026-09-18; one cache says 18/09/26; malformed feed says 2026-13-09 ROLE — canonical intent, probably Senior Frontend Engineer The title appears elsewhere as: ✨ Sr Front-End / Frontend / UI Platform Engineer — React⚛︎ + TypeScript | Toronto-ish / Canada REMOTE?? | FE-773 Senior; possible Staff leveling for exceptional scope, not a Staff requisition by default What this role actually focuses on: large React applications, design system/platform work, performance and accessibility. 📍 Location / geography chaos Primary-ish: Toronto, ON, Canada; remote within Canada; optional Vancouver hub. Aliases/noise: Toronto / T.O. / GTA / Greater Toronto Area / YYZ-ish / Ontario / Canada 🇨🇦 / Vancouver mentioned as optional hub; Seattle is customer office, NOT job location. Remote/hybrid note: Remote within Canada with quarterly team events; Toronto employees may use office; ATS says HYBRID although weekly attendance is not currently required. Do not use every city/country/provider-region mentioned in this document as the job location. 🧾 Employment type Full-time employee in Canada; fixed-term 12-month contract is a separate option for one headcount. This job is NOT automatically part-time just because an interview is 30 minutes, a sprint is 2 weeks, or a shift example contains 12 hours. What you'll do / responsibilities-ish • Own the role-specific outcomes described above. • Work with stakeholders across Product / Engineering / Ops / Legal / Finance / customers as relevant. • Document decisions and trade-offs; fix messy real-world inputs instead of assuming pristine source data. • Use metrics, but distinguish business/system metrics from compensation and candidate requirements. • Communicate clearly across functions and time zones. • Escalate risks instead of silently normalizing contradictory data. Required / must-have-ish 1) 5+ years frontend/software engineering, flexible for depth. 2) TypeScript, React, modern CSS, web performance, accessibility, testing, browser fundamentals, APIs. 3) English professional; French useful for Quebec customers but not required. 4) Evidence of shipping/operating/delivering work with real users, customers, patients, systems, or business consequences as appropriate. 5) Good judgment when requirements conflict across source systems. Preferred / nice-to-have / bonus Next.js, GraphQL, Node.js, Storybook, Playwright, design systems, observability. NO, seeing a tool in this list does not mean every item is mandatory. 💰 Compensation / pay — context matters CAD 145,000–185,000 base/year for Canada employee; 10% target bonus; equity may apply. Nearby numbers that are NOT necessarily salary: • USD $2.4M annual storefront GMV for one customer • CAD $1,500 home-office budget • US salary snippet $170k–$220k from a different requisition • A/B test uplift 7.25% Numbers may use commas, periods, spaces, apostrophes, k/K, local symbols, annual/monthly/hourly units and different currencies. Keep unit + jurisdiction + employment model together. 🕒 Schedule Typical business hours in local Canadian timezone; 3–4h overlap with ET; no regular on-call, rare launch support. A time inside an interview step, system SLA, customer event or service coverage statement is not automatically weekly work hours. Language English professional; French useful for Quebec customers but not required. Do not infer language requirements from city names or customer examples alone. How to apply Primary apply link: https://careers.example.net/jobs/fe-773?src=linkedin Recruiting contact: frontend-hiring@example.net Other emails may appear in privacy/security/customer examples; don't classify every email as recruiting. Interview process (illustrative; may vary) ① recruiter / talent conversation ~25–35 min ② hiring-manager or domain interview ~45–60 min ③ work sample / case / technical or practical discussion ④ cross-functional panel ⑤ final / references where legally appropriate Offer timing ≠ work schedule. ⚠️ Stale / merged content trap Old template: “Frontend Engineer II — Austin, TX — 3+ years — $120k–$150k.” This is NOT the current role. Related-jobs carousel contamination Related jobs widget: React Native Engineer — Montréal; Staff Design Systems Engineer — NYC; Backend Node Engineer — Remote US. Not aliases. Unicode / normalization trap React / Reaсt (one lookalike c), TypeScript / Type​Script, Montréal / Montréal, résumé / résumé. Visually identical tokens may not be byte-identical; byte-different tokens may still be semantically equivalent. Conversely, confusable characters can make malicious or corrupted text look normal.
